D.treatment: 10Academy skills training and mentored job pairing

cells.quote: In total, the intensive skills training and mentored job pairing conducted by 10Academy has led to 90% job placement of the organization’s 105 trainees, 38% of whom are women, and salaries 5x that of their peers.
cells.note: The study reports a salary contrast with peers, but does not state how the comparison was formed. The 90% job-placement figure has no comparison group and is therefore not coded as a cell.
